{{Quote|Colonel, we have a sort of strange transmission standing by for you&hellip;if you want to take it. It's a civilian who won't identify himself, says he's going to shake the armed services here until they crack, but it's nothing personal.''"<br />"''It's not my husband again, another of his jokes?''"<br />"''Not&hellip; this time.|Unidentified communications officer and Kadana Sorrel|<ref name="mk" />}}
This '''individual''' was a member of the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Force]] in [[44 ABY]], serving in [[Galactic Alliance Starfighter Command|Starfighter Command]] as a [[Communications officer/Legends|communications officer]]. At the time, he was stationed on [[Skifter Station]] in orbit over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]].<ref name="mk" />

During his tour there, he was on-duty when the station received a transmission for [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Kadana Sorrel]] from a civilian who wouldn't identify himself, but said he was going to shake the armed services until they cracked. The caller was a disguised [[Turman Durra]], a member of the Galactic Alliance [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]], though Durra was impersonating a long-dead Wraith named [[Ton Phanan]]. When the officer received the transmission, he informed the off-duty Sorrel of the message with a medium-priority tone, though he was puzzled by the message. She asked the communications officer if it was her [[Kadana Sorrel's husband|husband]] playing another joke, but he assured her that it was not.<ref name="mk" />

Sorrel agreed to take the message and ultimately responded by flying down to the surface of Kuratooine where the Wraiths exposed the head of the [[Galactic Alliance Army]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]], as a traitor.<ref name="mk" />
